svg.aria-label: Placing the cell in the Faraday shield or a metal oven: connect the black lead to the enclosure; keep the holder and leads off the walls, route the two lead groups apart, and place the thermocouple next to the holder. After reaching temperature, wait another 30 to 60 minutes. When measuring picoamp currents, the shield must be closed. Metal enclosures are often earth grounded, so the electrodes and holder must not touch the enclosure.
